weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a silicone pair (Dimethicone @7, Amodimethicone @11) with cationic guar and a prominent keratin film plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; the lipids are non-material and the C1 reset is effective.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Convergence of silicone + cationic + protein argues toward high; post-line Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13 (waxy) and Apricot Oil @20 are recorded as the counter-signal (W-LINE item 6).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicones plus guar plus a prominent keratin film are plausibly persistent depositing systems; calling it lightweight would understate residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no material payload lipid (Hydrogenated Castor Oil @13 and Apricot Oil @20 are after the W-line @8), so neither W-RICH nor a lipid leg exists; the remaining set is the silicone/guar/late-amodimethicone type in an SLES/betaine C1 chassis, whose holdout reading is moderate - W1 itself is not applied because the prominent keratin film (@6) is a further family under W1 (c), so the full method decides and the protein film is judged too light to make the coating persistent against the C1 reset. Not low: multiple plausibly persistent families (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-LINE item 6: the post-line lipids are what keeps the band from high, so confidence is at most moderate, neighbor high.
